XY series · GEN

Generations

Released February 22, 2016 · 117 cards

Expanded

Generations is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the XY series, released in English on February 22, 2016. Its main set has 83 cards, plus 34 secret rares numbered beyond the set (117 in total). It includes 89 Pokémon, 18 Trainer and 10 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).

Illustrators

45 illustrators worked on Generations. Most cards: 5ban Graphics (10), Eske Yoshinob (5), kirisAki (5), Naoki Saito (5), Toyste Beach (5), Atsuko Nishida (4), Aya Kusube (4), Mitsuhiro Arita (4).
